 All About L.A. Chargers QB Justin Herbert’s Romance With Madison Beer
 Alyssa Norwin • November 16, 2026, 4:32 pm 
 Justin Herbert and the Los Angeles Chargers haven’t had the best season (they have yet to win a game in 2026), but the quarterback still has the support of his fiancée amid his team’s struggles. Ahead of the 2026 football season, Herbert proposed to Madison Beer .
 The news was announced in a joint Instagram post in July with the caption, “Meet my fiancé.” The post included photos from Herbert’s proposal and the sweet moments afterward. Below, we rounded up everything to know about the pair’s romance and more.
 Who is Madison Beer?
 Beer is a singer who first gained recognition in 2012 when Justin Bieber posted a video of her singing a cover of Etta James’ “At Last” online. She eventually signed to his record label, but left in 2016 when she didn’t agree with the cookie-cutter image they wanted her to present.
 In 2021, she released her debut album, Life Support .  Silence Between Songs followed in 2023, and she put out her most recent release,  Locket , in 2026. Beer has been nominated for two Grammy Awards.
 Beer identifies as bisexual. She was previously in a relationship with Jack Gilinsky from 2015 to 2017, then Zack Bia in 2018 and 2019. Beer started dating influencer Nick Austin in 2020, but they split at some point before she and Herbert got together.
 How did Justin Herbert and Madison Beer meet?
 Herbert and Beer were first linked when he was spotted on the set of one of her music videos in August 2025. The two had just made their relationship official, with Herbert asking Beer to be his girlfriend on July 26 of that year.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Justin Herbert (@justinherbert) 
 They got engaged exactly one year after he asked her to be his girlfriend. “My heart can’t take it,” Beer later admitted. “Honestly, it makes me want to cry whenever I talk about it. But it was on our one-year of being official. We had been together, obviously, before he asked me to be his girlfriend, but it was on our official one-year anniversary.”
 In 2025, Herbert revealed that he met Beer through mutual friends and that their relationship started off platonic. After meeting for coffee and playing chess, things eventually turned romantic.

 When is Justin Herbert and Madison Beer’s wedding?
 While Herbert and Beer have not confirmed their wedding plans publicly, it’s likely they’ll get married in the first half of 2027 during the football offseason. Herbert’s season will come to an end in early January, and he won’t have to report back to training camp until July, so there is plenty of time to walk down the aisle!
 Who is Justin Herbert’s ex-girlfriend?
 Prior to his romance with Beer, Herbert did not have any public relationships. In 2021, he was linked to Taylor Bisciotti, an on-air reporter and host who covers the Chargers in Los Angeles.
 However, Herbert and Bisciotti have never confirmed the rumors about their romance and continue to work together professionally.
